title: Internet calling
subtitle: Calls placed inside DamDam. No eSIM needed.

mode.internetExplainer: Placed inside DamDam over your internet connection. Needs the microphone. Billed against your DamDam balance.
mode.carrierExplainer: Placed by your phone's own dialler on your eSIM. Billed by the carrier, not by DamDam. DamDam cannot start one for you.

destination.label: Number to call
destination.hint: Include the country code, for example +44 20 7946 0011
destination.invalid: Enter a number in international format, starting with +.

payer.label: Who pays
payer.workDisclosure: Your organization can see that this call happened, how long it lasted and what it cost. It cannot hear it.
payer.personalDisclosure: Billed to your own DamDam balance.
